title: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: SpaceCast-Bench: 评估视觉语言模型中的预测空间推理能力

paragraphs.en: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning : constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench , the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe–transform–infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的空间推理基准测试主要考察空间感知能力：即从输入中直接读取已经可见的关系。 然而，现实世界中的空间智能需要预测性空间推理：根据观察构建场景，预测干预措施将如何改变该场景，并推理出尚未观察到的结果。 我们提出了 SpaceCast-Bench，这是首个能够直接且有针对性地评估这一能力的基准测试。 该基准测试围绕“观察–转换–推断”框架构建，包含来自182个真实场景的3,862道问题，涵盖16种任务类型和三个难度层级：静态感知、局部预测和全局预测，逐步要求模型具备场景理解、空间状态更新以及对未观察结果进行关系推理的能力。 对21个模型进行评估后，暴露出显著的性能差距：表现最强的模型准确率仅为58.0%，而人类表现达到87.2%；专门针对空间推理的模型则仍接近随机水平。 受控分析进一步表明，桥接视图对于整合分散的观察信息至关重要，且显式的3D证据比生成的结果图像或视频能更稳定地提升模型性能。 在通过程序生成的数据上进行微调后，Qwen3-VL-4B的准确率从34.0%提升至65.7%，并在六个跨域基准测试中实现了宏观平均性能的提升。

paragraphs.en: Visual-spatial intelligence entails perceiving and mentally manipulating spatial relationships, encompassing relational reasoning and the ability to transform between egocentric and allocentric perspectives ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Gardner, 2011 ) . This capacity is fundamental for vision-language models to understand and act in the physical world. Recent benchmarks spanning single-image relation grounding ( Kamath et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ) , 3D metric estimation ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) , and multi-view integration ( Li et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2025a ) have driven rapid progress in spatial perception ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 视觉空间智能涉及对空间关系的感知与心智操控，包括关系推理以及在自我中心视角与他者中心视角之间转换的能力（Yang 等人，2025a；Gardner，2011）。 这种能力是视觉语言模型理解物理世界并在此世界中行动的基础。 近期涵盖单图像关系定位（Kamath 等人，2023；Du 等人，2024）、三维度量估计（Ma 等人，2025；Cheng 等人，2024）以及多视角整合（Li 等人，2025；Yang 等人，2026a；Yang 等人，2025a）的基准测试，推动了空间感知领域的快速进步（Ouyang 等人，2025；Wu 等人，2025；Li 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Yet these benchmarks share a fundamental limitation: they evaluate spatial perception , the ability to read off relations already present in the observed frames ( Tong et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2025a ) . What they overlook is spatial prediction , the ability to anticipate how a scene will be reconfigured after an intervention. Consider a robot retrieving an envelope beneath a book with a cup resting on top: to plan safely, it must predict that sliding the book will displace the cup and decide to move the cup first. This requires constructing a mental model of the scene, simulating the consequences of an action, and revising the plan accordingly. Such predictive spatial reasoning is a prerequisite for safe manipulation and multi-step planning, and precisely what spatial world models must learn ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2019 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) : represent an environment in a form that supports anticipating action consequences even when those consequences are never shown. Despite its centrality to embodied intelligence, no existing benchmark evaluates this capability in a controlled and diagnostically decomposable way.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些基准测试存在一个根本性的局限：它们评估的是空间感知能力，即从已观察到的画面中读取其中已经存在的空间关系的能力（Tong et al., 2024；Cheng et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2025a；Yang et al., 2025a）。 它们忽略的是空间预测能力，即预测在某种干预之后场景将如何重新配置的能力。 设想一个机器人正在从一本书下方取一个信封，而书上方则放着一个杯子：为了安全地规划操作，它必须预测移动书本会推动杯子，并决定先移动杯子。 这需要构建场景的心理模型，模拟某个动作可能带来的后果，并据此调整计划。 这种预测性的空间推理能力是安全操控和多步骤规划的前提条件，也是空间世界模型必须学会的核心能力（Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018；Hafner et al., 2019；Hafner et al., 2025；Assran et al., 2025）：即以一种能够预测动作后果的形式来表示环境，即使这些后果从未被直接展示过。 尽管这种能力对于具身智能至关重要，但目前没有任何现有的基准测试能够以受控且具备诊断分解性的方式评估这一能力。

paragraphs.en: To fill this gap, we introduce SpaceCast-Bench , the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate predictive spatial reasoning, comprising 3,862 questions from 182 scenes across 16 task types (Figure 1 ). Built around an observe–transform–infer framework, the benchmark progressively evaluates scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. To instantiate this at scale, we develop a geometry-grounded pipeline that builds question-conditioned, depth-verified view chains from posed RGB-D scans, applies controlled local or global transformations in 3D, and derives programmatic labels while keeping the resulting state unobserved. Tasks span three capability levels: L1 (Static Perception) , probing spatial relations in an unmodified scene from single- or multi-view observations; L2 (Local Prediction) , testing anticipation of relation changes after localized object-level interventions; and L3 (Global Prediction) , testing reasoning after a rigid transformation is applied to the entire layout. Across the benchmark, tasks cover direction, distance, visibility and occlusion, and attachment structure, with directional relations posed in camera-centric, object-centric, and world-centric reference frames, enabling granular diagnosis of where model reasoning breaks down.
paragraphs.zh: 为了填补这一空白，我们提出了 SpaceCast-Bench——首个能够直接且具诊断性地评估预测性空间推理能力的基准测试，该测试包含来自 16 种任务类型、182 个场景的 3,862 道问题（图 1）。 该基准测试围绕“观察–转换–推断”框架构建，逐步评估场景理解能力、空间状态更新能力以及对未观察结果的关联推理能力。 为实现大规模实例化，我们开发了一条基于几何学的基础流程：从给定的 RGB-D 扫描数据中构建受问题条件约束且经过深度验证的视角链，在三维空间中应用受控的局部或全局变换，并在保持结果状态未被观察的前提下生成程序化标签。 任务涵盖三个能力层级：L1（静态感知），通过单视角或多视角观察来探测未修改场景中的空间关系；L2（局部预测），测试在局部物体层面进行干预后对关系变化的预测能力；以及 L3（全局预测），测试对整个布局施加刚性变换后的推理能力。 在整个基准测试中，任务覆盖了方向、距离、可见性、遮挡和附着结构等要素，其中方向关系以相机中心、物体中心和世界中心的参考系提出，从而能够精细诊断模型推理失效的具体环节。

paragraphs.en: Experiments across 21 proprietary, open-weight, and spatially specialized models reveal a substantial gap: the strongest model achieves only 58.0% accuracy against human performance of 87.2%, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance, indicating that existing spatial training does not transfer to spatial state updating. Controlled analyses show that CoT ( Wei et al., 2022 ) prompting provides no consistent benefit, bridge views aid integration of distributed observations, and explicit 3D evidence benefits strong general-purpose models far more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Finally, post-training experiments show that benchmark-aligned training substantially improves Qwen3-VL-4B: staged SFT raises overall accuracy from 34.0% to 65.7% on SpaceCast-Bench and yields consistent gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks, confirming that our pipeline supports both systematic diagnosis and transferable model improvement.

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are as follows: (i) We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark for diagnostic evaluation of predictive spatial reasoning, with 3,862 questions from 182 scenes across 16 task types. (ii) We develop a geometry-grounded pipeline that builds depth-verified view chains, applies controlled 3D transformations, and programmatically derives labels for unobserved outcome states. (iii) We evaluate 21 models with controlled analyses revealing a substantial human–model gap and distinct bottlenecks across model families, and show that training on our generated data improves both in-domain and six out-of-domain benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下：(i) 我们提出了 SpaceCast-Bench，这是首个用于预测性空间推理诊断评估的基准测试，包含来自 16 种任务类型、182 个场景的 3,862 道问题。 (ii) 我们开发了一条基于几何学的处理流程，该流程能够构建经过深度验证的视图链，应用受控的三维变换，并以程序化方式推导出未观察到的结果状态的标签。 (iii) 我们对 21 个模型进行了评估，通过受控分析揭示了人类与模型之间存在显著差距，以及不同模型家族各自存在的明显瓶颈；同时我们发现，使用我们生成的数据进行训练能够提升模型在领域内基准测试以及六个跨领域基准测试中的表现。

paragraphs.en: Early spatial benchmarks evaluate relations in a single observed image. What’sUp ( Kamath et al., 2023 ) and EmbSpatial-Bench ( Du et al., 2024 ) focus on basic directional and embodied spatial questions, while SpatialRGPT-Bench ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) and 3DSRBench ( Ma et al., 2025 ) broaden the relation set using 3D annotations and natural scenes. All these benchmarks center on spatial perception of existing scenes, without requiring any reasoning about how relations change after an intervention.

paragraphs.en: Recent benchmarks have begun to evaluate reasoning over scene change. CLEVRER ( Yi et al., 2020 ) evaluates physical events and counterfactuals in synthetic collision videos, and SAT ( Ray et al., 2025 ) combines observed motion with hypothetical ego actions, with both grounded in observed evidence. MindCube ( Wang et al., 2026 ) studies what-if object motion from limited views, SpaMEM ( Liao et al., 2026 ) tests belief revision after object operations, and SpatialWorld ( Gao et al., 2026 ) evaluates agents that gather evidence and act in a closed loop. While these works touch on aspects of predictive reasoning, SpaceCast-Bench is the first comprehensive benchmark to directly evaluate predictive spatial reasoning under controlled scene transformations.

paragraphs.en: SpaceCast-Bench evaluates whether a vision-language model can anticipate how spatial relations change after an intervention it never observes. The initial scene state S 0 S_{0} is observed through an ordered sequence of RGB views 𝒪 = ( I 1 , … , I m ) \mathcal{O}=(I_{1},\ldots,I_{m}) sampled exclusively from the pre-transformation scene. Given 𝒪 \mathcal{O} , a natural-language transformation T T , and a spatial query q q , the model must evaluate q q in the unobserved result state S 1 = F ⁡ ( S 0 , T ) S_{1}=F(S_{0},T) . This requires three latent operations: integrating 𝒪 \mathcal{O} to recover the relevant portion of S 0 S_{0} , applying T T to obtain S 1 S_{1} , and evaluating q q in S 1 S_{1} . This observe–transform–infer pipeline distinguishes predictive spatial reasoning from the perceptual task of reading off relations already visible in the input.

paragraphs.en: As illustrated by the representative task instances in Figure 3 , we organize tasks into three capability levels of increasing demand. L1 (Static Perception) sets T T to the identity, so S 1 = S 0 S_{1}=S_{0} and the queried relation is directly recoverable from 𝒪 \mathcal{O} . These tasks probe spatial perception across direction, distance, visibility and occlusion, and attachment structure from single- or multi-view observations, establishing a perceptual baseline and isolating failures in the observe stage from those in the transform–infer stages. L2 (Local Prediction) applies a localized intervention to a single object, translating, orbiting, or removing it together with its attachment dependents, while leaving the rest of the scene intact. These tasks test whether the model can simulate an object-level action and evaluate the queried relation in the unobserved S 1 S_{1} without corrupting its representation of unaffected regions. L3 (Global Prediction) applies a rigid yaw rotation to the complete layout, requiring a scene representation explicitly decoupled from the observed camera perspective and robust to conflation of scene rotation with a viewpoint change.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 3 中所示的典型任务实例所表明的那样，我们将任务按照需求递增的三个能力层级进行组织。 L1（静态感知）将 T T 设为恒等变换，因此 S 1 = S 0 S_{1}=S_{0}，且所查询的关系可以直接从 𝒪 \mathcal{O} 中恢复。 这些任务通过单视角或多视角观察，检验空间感知在方向、距离、可见性、遮挡和附着结构方面的能力，从而建立感知基准，并将观察阶段的失败与变换–推理阶段的失败区分开来。 L2（局部预测）对单个对象实施局部干预，将其连同其附着的依赖对象一起进行平移、环绕或移除，同时保持场景其余部分不变。 这些任务旨在检验模型是否能够模拟对象级别的操作，并在未观察到的 S 1 S_{1} 中评估所查询的关系，而不会破坏其对未受影响区域的表示。 L3（全局预测）对整个布局实施刚性偏航旋转，这要求场景表示必须明确脱离观察到的摄像头视角，并且能够抵抗将场景旋转与视角变化相混淆的情况。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 summarizes our four-stage benchmark construction pipeline, built from 134 ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) and 48 ScanNet++ ( Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ) scenes. Each scene provides RGB images with calibrated camera poses, depth maps, reconstructed 3D geometry, and instance-level semantic annotations; we derive each instance’s surface geometry, 3D center, and axis-aligned bounding box from its mesh. We additionally construct a directed attachment graph where a parent-to-child edge indicates that displacing the parent also displaces the child; edges are proposed from surface contact, support overlap, and semantic compatibility, with each child assigned at most one parent. The transitive closure of this graph determines co-movement under local interventions and is used to generate attachment-chain questions. For each task type, we enumerate candidate object tuples and select a view chain grounded in their spatial arrangement.

paragraphs.en: Cross-view questions require two anchor views such that each anchor exposes its assigned query-object group while excluding the other. Candidate anchors are filtered by camera validity, image quality, projected object area, and geometric visibility, then selected to satisfy mutual semantic disjointness: neither anchor reveals the objects assigned to the other. Bridge views connect the two anchors via a depth-verified corridor between the aggregate centers of the two object groups; each consecutive pair must overlap the corridor by at least 10% and advance toward the opposite anchor, and no bridge view may re-expose both groups. The resulting view chain is ordered along the selected traversal and contains only pre-transformation observations. Three task types require a single anchor; the remaining 13 use the disjoint-anchor construction.
paragraphs.zh: 跨视角问题需要两个锚点视角，使得每个锚点都能呈现其分配给它的查询对象组，同时排除另一个对象组。 候选锚点会依据相机有效性、图像质量、投影对象面积和几何可见性进行筛选，然后选择满足相互语义分离的条件：即任一锚点都不会揭示分配给另一个锚点的对象。 桥梁视角通过两个对象组的聚合中心之间经过深度验证的走廊连接这两个锚点；每对连续的视角必须与该走廊重叠至少10%，并朝向对面的锚点推进，且任何桥梁视角都不能重新呈现两个对象组。 最终生成的视角链会按照所选的遍历顺序排列，并且仅包含变换前的观察数据。 三种任务类型需要一个锚点；其余13种则使用分离锚点的构建方式。

sents.en: Candidate anchors are filtered by camera validity, image quality, projected object area, and geometric visibility, then selected to satisfy mutual semantic disjointness: neither anchor reveals the objects assigned to the other.

sents.en: Bridge views connect the two anchors via a depth-verified corridor between the aggregate centers of the two object groups; each consecutive pair must overlap the corridor by at least 10% and advance toward the opposite anchor, and no bridge view may re-expose both groups.
sents.zh: 桥梁视角通过两个对象组的聚合中心之间经过深度验证的走廊连接这两个锚点；每对连续的视角必须与该走廊重叠至少10%，并朝向对面的锚点推进，且任何桥梁视角都不能重新呈现两个对象组。

sents.en: The resulting view chain is ordered along the selected traversal and contains only pre-transformation observations.
sents.zh: 最终生成的视角链会按照所选的遍历顺序排列，并且仅包含变换前的观察数据。

sents.en: Three task types require a single anchor; the remaining 13 use the disjoint-anchor construction.
sents.zh: 三种任务类型需要一个锚点；其余13种则使用分离锚点的构建方式。

paragraphs.en: Given the object tuple and view chain, we compute relation labels directly from 3D geometry according to the task type. Direction projects object centers onto the floor plane and resolves their relative vector into eight horizontal sectors plus above and below; camera-centric, object-centric, and world-centric variants express this vector in the designated coordinate frame. Distance approximates the shortest surface-to-surface separation using sampled mesh points and maps it to four categorical bins of increasing distance. Visibility and occlusion use mesh ray casting from the calibrated camera center, with aggregated outcomes distinguishing not occluded, occluded, and not visible. Attachment queries the transitive closure of the attachment graph, requiring exact-set identification of all objects displaced when a root is moved. For predictive questions, we apply the specified transformation to the relevant object geometry, translating, orbiting, or removing an object or rotating the complete layout, and rerun the engine on the resulting state to obtain the ground-truth label. Geometrically ambiguous cases, labels near decision boundaries, and invalid motion endpoints are excluded across all relation families.
paragraphs.zh: 根据对象元组和视图链，我们依据任务类型直接从三维几何中计算关系标签。 方向将对象中心投影到地面平面，并将其相对向量分解为八个水平扇区以及上方和下方；以相机为中心、以对象为中心和以世界为中心的变体分别在该向量于指定坐标系中的表示。 距离通过采样网格点近似表面间的最短距离，并将其映射到四个按距离递增的分类区间。 可见性和遮挡使用经校准的相机中心发出的网格射线投射法进行判断，汇总结果区分非遮挡、遮挡和不可见状态。 附着查询附着图的传递闭包，要求精确识别移动根对象时所有被位移的对象集合。 对于预测性问题，我们将指定的变换应用于相关对象的几何结构，包括平移、环绕或移除某个对象，或旋转整个布局，然后对结果状态重新运行引擎以获得真实标签。 几何上存在歧义的情况、接近决策边界的标签以及无效的移动终点在所有关系类别中均被排除。

paragraphs.en: We combine automatic filtering with human verification to ensure geometric validity and question clarity. Automatic filtering removes geometrically ambiguous relations, labels near decision boundaries, invalid motion endpoints, insufficient visual grounding, and near-duplicates defined by scene, view, task type, and object identity. Answer positions are balanced within the generated pool before the benchmark is frozen. Human verification was conducted by 10 annotators, with every question receiving at least two independent reviews based on the model-visible input; reviewers checked object identifiability, visual answerability, and question clarity, with disagreements resolved by a third reviewer. Before adjudication, single-answer questions achieved 98.9% pairwise agreement and attachment-chain questions achieved 91.8% exact-set agreement. See Appendix B for complete task definitions, construction details, and quality-control procedures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将自动过滤与人工验证相结合，以确保几何有效性和问题清晰度。 自动过滤会移除几何上模糊的关系、靠近决策边界的标签、无效的终点、视觉依据不足的情况，以及由场景、视角、任务类型和物体身份定义的近似重复项。 在基准测试冻结之前，答案位置会在生成的候选池中经过平衡处理。 人工验证由 10 名标注员执行，每个问题都基于模型可见的输入获得了至少两次独立审核；审核员检查了物体的可识别性、答案的视觉可验证性以及问题的清晰度，意见分歧则由第三名审核员解决。 在最终裁定之前，单答案题实现了 98.9% 的成对一致性，而附着链问题则实现了 91.8% 的精确集合一致性。 完整任务定义、构建细节和质量控制流程请参见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 summarizes the benchmark composition. The benchmark contains 3,862 questions across 182 scenes and 16 task types, drawn from the validation splits of ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) and ScanNet++ ( Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ) . paragraphs.en: We evaluate 21 models in 3 groups: 9 proprietary models, 6 general-purpose open-weight models, and 6 spatially specialized models. The proprietary set includes Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Sonnet 5 ( Anthropic, 2026a ; Anthropic, 2026b ) ; Gemini 3.5 Flash and Gemini 3 Flash ( Google, 2026 ; Google, 2025 ) ; GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.6-Luna ( OpenAI, 2026c ; OpenAI, 2026a ) ; Doubao 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed Team, 2026 ) ; and Qwen3.6-Flash and Qwen3.7-Plus ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) . The general-purpose open-weight set comprises InternVL3.5-8B ( InternVL Team, 2025 ) , Qwen3-VL-4B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , and Qwen3.5 models at 2B, 4B, 9B, and 27B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) . The spatially specialized set contains VST-7B-RL ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , SenseNova-SI-1.2 ( Cai et al., 2026 ) , Cambrian-S-7B ( Yang et al., 2025c ) , SpaceR ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) , SpatialLadder ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and Spatial-MLLM-v1.1 ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . All models are evaluated with a chain-of-thought prompt and deterministic decoding.

paragraphs.en: Our primary metric is the overall score, defined as the unweighted macro-average of per-task accuracy across all 16 task types. We additionally report Static, Local, and Global averages, each computed as the macro-average over the task types in the corresponding transformation family. paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports accuracy across all 16 task types. Human-level performance stands at 87.2%, providing an upper bound against which all models fall substantially short. Among proprietary models, Gemini 3.5 Flash leads at 58.0%, followed by Gemini 3 Flash (56.7%) and Qwen3.7-Plus (55.3%), with the remaining models ranging down to 36.0% (Claude Sonnet 4.6); even the best model trails human level by 29.2 pp, highlighting the substantial headroom that remains. The strongest general-purpose open-weight model, Qwen3.5-27B, reaches 39.3%, 18.7 pp below the top proprietary model and 47.9 pp below human level. Spatially specialized models score lowest overall (25.7–29.1%), falling below every proprietary and general-purpose open-weight model despite being explicitly trained for spatial tasks, and remain near the random baseline of 25.9%, suggesting that current spatial fine-tuning paradigms have yet to instill genuine spatial reasoning capabilities. See Appendix D for qualitative analysis and representative failure cases.

paragraphs.en: Predictive reasoning is broadly harder than static perception, though the pattern differs across model groups. Proprietary and general-purpose open-weight models both score lower on L2 than L1, with the largest drops for Gemini 3.5 Flash ( − 21.8 -21.8 pp), Qwen3.7-Plus ( − 20.6 -20.6 pp), and Qwen3.6-Flash ( − 18.3 -18.3 pp). Spatially specialized models show a slightly higher group average on L2 than L1, yet all three groups decline on L3 relative to L1. The strongest proprietary models recover substantially at L3 (Gemini 3.5 Flash: L2 45.3%, L3 69.4%; Qwen3.7-Plus: L2 43.2%, L3 66.6%), reflecting strong performance on global rotation tasks where a holistic grasp of spatial layout appears sufficient. Spatially specialized models instead show markedly lower L3 averages (e.g., SenseNova-SI-1.2: L2 30.5%, L3 16.1%; Cambrian-S-7B: L2 28.8%, L3 17.1%), suggesting that spatial fine-tuning reinforces local perceptual features while leaving global spatial awareness undeveloped. These opposing patterns point to fundamentally different capability profiles rather than a uniform scaling of spatial reasoning.

paragraphs.en: Recent work suggests that generative world models can support spatial reasoning by providing imagined observations of future scene states ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Cao et al., 2026 ) . Motivated by this, we test whether external evidence can alleviate different bottlenecks in our observe–transform–infer pipeline, using the same six representative models as in Figure 6 . We consider two evidence families: explicit 3D evidence augments S 0 S_{0} with a BEV image or textual 3D metadata, while world-model evidence approximates S 1 S_{1} via post-intervention images from Qwen-Image-Edit ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) or GPT-image-2 ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , or a transformation video from Seedance2-mini ( ByteDance, 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows that general-purpose models effectively exploit explicit 3D evidence. Both proprietary and open-weight models improve with BEV images, and textual 3D metadata yields substantially larger gains (+30.7 pp and +10.9 pp, respectively). The stronger response among proprietary models suggests that recovering 3D structure from visual observations is a primary bottleneck: once made explicit, these models can perform the subsequent transformation and relational reasoning. Spatially specialized models show little benefit and decline with 3D metadata ( − 3.3 -3.3 pp), suggesting that fine-tuning without such evidence reduces their ability to exploit unfamiliar spatial representations.
paragraphs.zh: 图7显示，通用模型能有效利用显式的3D证据。 专有模型和开放权重模型在使用BEV图像后表现均有提升，而文本形式的3D元数据带来的增益则显著更大（分别提升+30.7个百分点和+10.9个百分点）。 专有模型表现出更强的响应，这表明从视觉观察中恢复3D结构是主要瓶颈：一旦该结构被显式化，这些模型就能执行后续的转换和关系推理。 空间特化模型在引入3D元数据后几乎未获收益，反而表现下降（−3.3个百分点），这说明在没有此类证据的情况下进行微调会削弱它们利用不熟悉的空间表示的能力。

paragraphs.en: World-model evidence produces much smaller and less consistent changes. To determine whether this reflects generation failures or ineffective evidence use, we manually audit generated endpoints for 600 local-intervention questions. Among incorrect responses across 6 representative models, 80.3% under Qwen-Image-Edit and 38.3% under GPT-image-2 are associated with generation failures, including artifacts, missing objects, deformation, and scale or perspective mismatch. Errors that persist after successful generation reveal a second bottleneck: even given an approximate S 1 S_{1} , models must still align the synthesized endpoint with the original multi-view evidence. Closing this gap thus requires advances on both generation fidelity and cross-view evidence integration.

paragraphs.en: We train Qwen3-VL-4B with SFT and GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) to assess whether standard post-training can improve predictive spatial reasoning and whether models trained on our dataset generalize to other spatial reasoning benchmarks. The training set is generated by the same programmatic pipeline, covering all 16 task types from scenes disjoint from the benchmark. We compare Mixed SFT (joint sampling over all task types) with Staged SFT (L1 first, then L2/L3 with L1 replay). SFT trains rank-32 LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) adapters on all language-model linear layers and the multimodal aligner (vision encoder frozen), with peak learning rates of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and 10 − 5 10^{-5} . GRPO uses the same staged schedule with rank-16 adapters and learning rates of 10 − 5 10^{-5} and 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 SFT 和 GRPO（Shao 等人，2024）训练 Qwen3-VL-4B，以评估标准的后训练方法能否提升预测性空间推理能力，以及基于我们数据集训练的模型能否泛化到其他空间推理基准测试中。 训练集由相同的程序化流程生成，涵盖了与基准测试场景完全分离的全部 16 种任务类型。 我们将混合 SFT（在所有任务类型上进行联合采样）与分阶段 SFT（先训练 L1，再训练 L2/L3 并重复 L1）进行比较。 SFT 在所有语言模型的线性层和多模态对齐器（视觉编码器保持冻结）上训练秩为 32 的 LoRA（Hu 等人，2021）适配器，峰值学习率分别为 10⁻⁴ 和 10⁻⁵。 GRPO 采用相同的分阶段方案，使用秩为 16 的适配器，学习率分别为 10⁻⁵ 和 5×10⁻⁶。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 shows that both SFT variants substantially improve predictive spatial reasoning on SpaceCast-Bench, with Mixed SFT reaching 64.8% and Staged SFT reaching 65.7% overall. Staged SFT improves Local performance from 51.3% to 54.0%, suggesting that progressively introducing higher-level task families benefits local state updating, while Mixed SFT is slightly stronger on Global tasks (73.1% vs. 70.8%). GRPO reaches 37.7% overall and performs best on Global tasks (45.7%), but remains substantially below both SFT variants, suggesting that task difficulty limits the model’s ability to obtain consistent reward signals for effective on-policy training.
paragraphs.zh: 表4显示，两种SFT变体都显著提升了模型在SpaceCast-Bench上的预测空间推理能力，其中混合SFT的整体准确率达到64.8%，分阶段SFT则达到65.7%。 分阶段SFT将局部任务的性能从51.3%提升至54.0%，表明逐步引入更高级别任务家族有助于局部状态的更新；而混合SFT在全局任务上的表现略强（73.1% vs. 70.8%）。 GRPO的整体准确率达到37.7%，在全局任务上的表现最佳（45.7%），但仍明显低于两种SFT变体，说明任务难度限制了模型获取一致奖励信号以实现有效在线策略训练的能力。

paragraphs.en: As Table 4 shows, both SFT variants transfer beyond SpaceCast-Bench across six OOD benchmarks ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Mirzaee et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Yi et al., 2020 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) spanning multi-image and language-grounded spatial reasoning, limited-view mental modeling, physical event understanding, and dynamic video-based spatial reasoning. Staged SFT achieves the strongest macro average (38.1%), exceeding Mixed SFT (37.2%) and the base model (33.5%), with the largest gains on DSI-Bench (+10.2 pp), SPARTQA (+6.0 pp), CLEVRER (+5.8 pp), and VSI-Bench (+4.7 pp), while MindCube remains slightly below the base model. GRPO shows a distinct transfer profile, with substantial gains on MindCube and DSI-Bench, smaller improvements on VSI-Bench and MMSI, and slight declines on SPARTQA and CLEVRER. Despite their different transfer profiles, both SFT and GRPO improve the out-of-domain macro average over the base model, demonstrating that training on SpaceCast-Bench data yields transferable spatial reasoning gains regardless of the post-training paradigm.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 4 所示，两种 SFT 变体都在六个 OOD 基准测试中实现了超越 SpaceCast-Bench 的迁移效果（Yang et al., 2026a; Mirzaee et al., 2021; Wang et al., 2026; Yi et al., 2020; Yang et al., 2025a; Zhang et al., 2025b），这些测试涵盖多图像与语言引导的空间推理、受限视角的心理建模、物理事件理解以及动态视频基础的空间推理。 分阶段 SFT 实现了最强的宏观平均值（38.1%），超过了混合 SFT（37.2%）和基础模型（33.5%），其中在 DSI-Bench（+10.2 pp）、SPARTQA（+6.0 pp）、CLEVRER（+5.8 pp）和 VSI-Bench（+4.7 pp）上的提升最大，而 MindCube 的表现仍略低于基础模型。 GRPO 展现出不同的迁移特征：在 MindCube 和 DSI-Bench 上取得显著提升，在 VSI-Bench 和 MMSI 上的改进较小，而在 SPARTQA 和 CLEVRER 上则略有下降。 尽管 SFT 和 GRPO 的迁移特征不同，但两者都提升了模型在域外任务上的宏观平均值，超过了基础模型，这表明基于 SpaceCast-Bench 数据的训练能够带来可迁移的空间推理能力提升，无论后续训练范式如何。

paragraphs.en: We introduced SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate predictive spatial reasoning, where tasks progress from understanding observed scenes to updating spatial states and inferring relations in unobserved outcomes. Experiments reveal a substantial human–model gap and show that existing spatial training does not transfer to spatial state updating. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data yields consistent gains both in-domain and across six out-of-domain benchmarks, suggesting that predictive spatial reasoning represents a distinct and largely unsolved capability that SpaceCast-Bench is positioned to drive progress on.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SpaceCast-Bench，这是首个能够直接且具诊断性地评估预测性空间推理能力的基准测试。其中，任务从理解已观察到的场景开始，逐步过渡到更新空间状态，并推断未观察结果中的关系。 实验揭示了人类与模型之间存在显著差距，并表明现有的空间训练无法迁移到空间状态的更新任务中。 在我们通过程序生成的数据上进行微调，无论是在领域内还是在六个跨领域的基准测试中，都带来了持续的性能提升。这表明预测性空间推理是一项独特且尚未被充分解决的能力，而 SpaceCast-Bench 有望推动该能力的进步。

paragraphs.en: SpaceCast-Bench comprises 3,862 questions drawn from 182 ScanNet and ScanNet++ scenes, all of which are indoor environments; ScanNet++ alone contributes 3,144 questions. Consequently, the benchmark does not cover outdoor settings or object arrangements and scales absent from these two sources. Question labels depend on reconstructed meshes, depth maps, camera poses, and instance-level semantic annotations, so geometric errors can affect ray-cast visibility, apparent surface contact or support relationships, and whether a queried object is sufficiently recognizable in a selected view. We exclude geometrically ambiguous cases and require independent review by at least two annotators per question, though these measures cannot fully eliminate reconstruction-related uncertainty in occlusion and attachment labels, particularly for objects with incomplete geometry or low reconstruction confidence. Finally, the three intervention types (translations, rotations, and removals) update scene geometry programmatically without simulating physical dynamics, so the benchmark does not assess deformation, friction, or collision-driven motion effects.
paragraphs.zh: SpaceCast-Bench 包含从 182 个 ScanNet 和 ScanNet++ 场景中提取的 3,862 个问题，所有问题均属于室内环境；其中仅 ScanNet++ 就贡献了 3,144 个问题。 因此，该基准测试未涵盖户外场景或这两个数据源中不存在的事物排列与尺度。 问题的标签依赖于重建的网格、深度图、相机姿态和实例级语义标注，因此几何错误可能会影响光线投射的可见性、表面的表观接触或支撑关系，以及被查询的对象在选定视角中是否足够可识别。 我们排除了具有几何歧义的情况，并要求每个问题至少由两名标注员独立审核；但这些措施无法完全消除重建相关的遮挡和附着标签的不确定性，尤其对于几何结构不完整或重建置信度较低的对象而言。 最后，三种干预类型（平移、旋转和移除）通过程序化方式更新场景几何，而未模拟物理动态过程，因此该基准测试不评估形变、摩擦或由碰撞驱动的运动效应。

paragraphs.en: SpaceCast-Bench is generated from the validation splits of ScanNet and ScanNet++, which provide registered RGB-D observations, calibrated camera poses, reconstructed scene geometry, and instance-level semantic annotations. The evaluation set comprises 3,862 unique questions spanning 16 task types across 182 indoor scenes: 718 questions from 134 ScanNet scenes and 3,144 from 48 ScanNet++ scenes. The same generation pipeline independently produces a training pool of 12,249 unique questions covering all 16 task types from 54 disjoint training scenes. No scene identifier is shared between the training pool and the evaluation set.
paragraphs.zh: SpaceCast-Bench 由 ScanNet 和 ScanNet++ 的验证分割集生成，这些分割集提供了配准的 RGB-D 观测数据、经过校准的相机姿态、重建的场景几何结构以及实例级别的语义标注。 评估集包含 3,862 个唯一问题，涵盖 182 个室内场景中的 16 种任务类型：其中 718 个问题来自 134 个 ScanNet 场景，3,144 个问题来自 48 个 ScanNet++ 场景。 相同的生成流程独立地生成了一个包含 12,249 个唯一问题的训练池，这些问题覆盖了 54 个互不重叠的训练场景中的所有 16 种任务类型。 训练池和评估集之间没有任何场景标识符是共享的。

paragraphs.en: For each cross-view question, the generator partitions the queried object roles into two identity-disjoint groups, 𝒢 A \mathcal{G}_{A} and 𝒢 B \mathcal{G}_{B} . Candidate anchor views are filtered by camera validity, image quality, projected object area, and geometric visibility. Anchor A A is selected only when every role in 𝒢 A \mathcal{G}_{A} is referable in A A and no role in 𝒢 B \mathcal{G}_{B} is meaningfully visible there; anchor B B satisfies the symmetric condition. This target disjointness applies to the queried objects, not to the entire image content.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个跨视角问题，生成器将所查询的对象角色划分为两个身份互斥的组：𝒢 A \mathcal{G}_{A} 和 𝒢 B \mathcal{G}_{B}。 候选锚点视角通过相机有效性、图像质量、投影对象面积和几何可见性进行筛选。 仅当 𝒢 A \mathcal{G}_{A} 中的每个角色在 A A 中均可指代，且 𝒢 B \mathcal{G}_{B} 中没有任何角色在该视角中有意义的可见时，才会选择锚点 A A；锚点 B B 满足对称条件。 这种目标互斥性适用于所查询的对象，而非整个图像内容。

paragraphs.en: Direction is computed from the relative vector between object centers. Its floor-plane projection is quantized into eight 45-degree sectors, while a separate vertical rule assigns above or below . Camera-centric questions express the vector in the designated camera’s horizontal axes, object-centric questions use a local frame defined by the reference object’s stated facing direction, and world-centric questions use the scene’s cardinal axes. Pairs near a directional decision boundary are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 方向是根据物体中心之间的相对向量计算得出的。 其地板平面投影被量化为八个 45 度的扇区，而一个独立的垂直规则则用于判断其在上方或下方。 以相机为中心的问题将向量表示在指定相机的水平轴上，以物体为中心的问题使用由参考物体所陈述的朝向定义的局部坐标系，而以世界为中心的问题则使用场景的基本方向轴。 位于方向决策边界附近的成对情况会被排除。

paragraphs.en: Distance approximates the shortest surface-to-surface separation between two instances using sampled mesh points with local triangle refinement. When surface samples are unavailable, the fallback uses the closest points on their 3D bounding boxes. The result is mapped to four categories: very close ( < 1.0 <1.0 m), close ( 1.0 1.0 – 2.0 2.0 m), moderate ( 2.0 2.0 – 3.3 3.3 m), and far ( > 3.3 >3.3 m). Questions within 0.1 m of a category boundary are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 该距离通过局部三角形细化对采样网格点进行处理，从而近似两个实例之间的最短表面到表面间距。 当无法获取表面样本时，备用方案会使用其三维边界框上的最近点。 结果被映射到四个类别：非常近（< 1.0 <1.0 米）、近（1.0 1.0 – 2.0 2.0 米）、中等（2.0 2.0 – 3.3 3.3 米）和远（> 3.3 >3.3 米）。 与类别边界在 0.1 米以内的问题将被排除。

sents.en: Distance approximates the shortest surface-to-surface separation between two instances using sampled mesh points with local triangle refinement.
sents.zh: 该距离通过局部三角形细化对采样网格点进行处理，从而近似两个实例之间的最短表面到表面间距。

sents.en: When surface samples are unavailable, the fallback uses the closest points on their 3D bounding boxes.
sents.zh: 当无法获取表面样本时，备用方案会使用其三维边界框上的最近点。

sents.en: The result is mapped to four categories: very close ( < 1.0 <1.0 m), close ( 1.0 1.0 – 2.0 2.0 m), moderate ( 2.0 2.0 – 3.3 3.3 m), and far ( > 3.3 >3.3 m).
Questions within 0.1 m of a category boundary are excluded.
sents.zh: 与类别边界在 0.1 米以内的问题将被排除。

paragraphs.en: The relation engine samples points on a target mesh, projects them into the calibrated camera, and ray casts each sample against the reconstructed scene mesh. A sample is considered visible when the target is the first valid intersection at the expected distance; a closer non-target intersection indicates external occlusion. Aggregated ray outcomes and camera-facing probes together distinguish three states: not occluded, occluded, and not visible. Removal questions recompute visibility after the specified deletion, while movement questions compute directed pairwise occlusion between the queried objects.
paragraphs.zh: 关系引擎在目标网格上采样点，将其投影到经过校准的相机中，并对每个样本向重建的场景网格进行射线投射。 当目标在预期距离处是第一个有效交点时，该样本被视为可见；如果存在更近的非目标交点，则表明发生了外部遮挡。 聚合后的射线结果与朝向相机的探测器共同区分三种状态：未被遮挡、被遮挡以及不可见。 移除问题会在指定删除操作后重新计算可见性，而移动问题则会计算所查询对象之间的定向成对遮挡关系。

paragraphs.en: The generator constructs a directed attachment graph from 3D contact, horizontal support overlap or containment, and semantic compatibility. Every child has at most one parent, and cycle-forming edges are rejected. The transitive descendants of a moved root define the component that moves with it; attachment-chain questions require exact-set identification of these descendants.
paragraphs.zh: 生成器基于三维接触、水平支撑重叠或包含关系以及语义兼容性构建一个有向连接图。 每个子节点最多只有一个父节点，且会拒绝形成循环的边。 被移动根节点的传递性后代定义了随其移动的组件；连接链问题需要精确识别这些后代的完整集合。

sents.en: The generator constructs a directed attachment graph from 3D contact, horizontal support overlap or containment, and semantic compatibility.
sents.zh: 生成器基于三维接触、水平支撑重叠或包含关系以及语义兼容性构建一个有向连接图。

paragraphs.en: L1 evaluates relations in the unmodified scene. For L2, object translations displace a selected root and its attachment descendants in the specified movement frame; object rotations move the component along a horizontal orbit of 45, 90, 135, or 180 degrees around a static pivot while preserving the moved object’s intrinsic facing direction. Removal applies the specified deletion before visibility is recomputed. For L3, global transformations rotate the complete layout by 90, 180, or 270 degrees while keeping the designated camera fixed. The relation engine is rerun on the resulting 3D state to obtain the programmatic label. Candidates that would leave the estimated room bounds or introduce a new strict 3D bounding-box collision are rejected.
paragraphs.zh: L1 评估未修改场景中的关系。 对于 L2，对象平移会将选定的根对象及其附着的子对象在指定的移动帧中重新定位；对象旋转则使组件围绕静态枢轴沿水平轨道旋转 45、90、135 或 180 度，同时保持被移动对象的原始朝向。 移除操作会在重新计算可见性之前应用指定的删除操作。 对于 L3，全局变换会将整个布局旋转 90、180 或 270 度，同时保持指定的相机固定不动。 在生成的 3D 状态上重新运行关系引擎，以获得程序化标签。 任何会导致超出预估房间边界或引入新的严格 3D 边界框碰撞的候选方案都将被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Question templates instantiate the transformation, object roles, requested reference frame, and answer candidates. Template variants for L1, L2, and L3 are shown in Tables 6 – 8 . Direction and distance tasks use four answer choices. Horizontal direction candidates are spaced at 90-degree intervals on the eight-direction ring so that adjacent directional labels do not serve as ambiguous distractors. Occlusion tasks use three choices, while attachment-chain questions are four-option multiple-selection items scored by exact set match. Semantic ground truth is computed before option order is randomized, and answer positions are balanced across the generated pool.
paragraphs.zh: 问题模板具体化了转换过程、对象角色、所要求的参考框架以及候选答案。 L1、L2 和 L3 的模板变体展示在表 6 – 8 中。 方向与距离任务使用四个选项。 水平方向的候选答案在八向环上以 90 度间隔分布，以确保相邻的方向标签不会成为模棱两可的干扰项。 遮挡任务使用三个选项，而附着链问题则是四选多的多选题目，通过完全匹配集合进行评分。 语义基准事实在选项顺序随机化之前计算得出，且答案位置在整个生成的题库中保持平衡。

paragraphs.en: Automatic filtering removes geometrically ambiguous relations, distance labels near category boundaries, invalid motion endpoints, insufficiently grounded objects, and near-duplicate questions. Because finite 3D reconstruction accuracy is especially consequential for occlusion, attachment, and referability, these properties also undergo human verification. Ten annotators reviewed the benchmark; every question was independently assessed by at least two annotators who were blind to each other’s decisions and to the programmatic answer. Disagreements were referred to a third annotator, who first made a blind judgment from the model-visible input and could consult geometry and generation traces only afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 自动过滤可移除几何结构模糊的关系、靠近类别边界的距离标签、无效的终点、支撑不足的对象以及近乎重复的问题。 由于有限的三维重建精度对遮挡、附着和可指代性尤为关键，这些属性也需要经过人工验证。 十名标注员对基准数据集进行了审核；每个问题都由至少两名彼此不知晓对方决策且未看到程序答案的标注员独立评估。 存在分歧的问题会提交给第三名标注员，该标注员首先基于模型可见的输入进行盲判，之后才能查阅几何信息和生成痕迹。

sents.zh: 自动过滤可移除几何结构模糊的关系、靠近类别边界的距离标签、无效的终点、支撑不足的对象以及近乎重复的问题。

paragraphs.en: Prior to adjudication, the 3,801 single-answer questions received 7,602 initial ratings with 98.9% pairwise answer agreement. Reviewers disagreed on the answer for 42 questions and on answerability for a further 42 questions; the two categories overlapped on 15 questions, yielding 69 unique questions sent to third-review adjudication. For the 97 attachment-chain questions, reviewers achieved 91.8% exact-set agreement. The complete quality-control process produced 157 ground-truth corrections, 143 question or option rewrites, and 36 removals, with 38 questions receiving both a ground-truth correction and a rewrite. All rewritten questions were independently reviewed by two annotators before inclusion.
paragraphs.zh: 在裁决之前，这 3,801 道单选问题获得了 7,602 次初始评分，两两答案一致率达到了 98.9%。 评审员对 42 道题目的答案存在分歧，另有 42 道题目的可回答性也存在争议；这两个类别在 15 道题目上重叠，最终有 69 道独特问题被提交给第三方评审进行裁决。 对于 97 道附件链问题，评审员实现了 91.8% 的精确集合一致率。 整个质量控制流程共产生了 157 处事实基准修正、143 处问题或选项重写以及 36 处删除，其中 38 道题目同时获得了事实基准修正和重写。 所有经过重写的题目在纳入之前，都由两名标注员进行了独立审核。

paragraphs.en: The primary SpaceCast-Bench evaluation uses a standardized chain-of-thought (CoT) prompt with deterministic decoding. The CoT condition requests brief reasoning followed by the final option on the last line; the Direct condition requests only the final option. Single-choice questions are scored by the selected option, and attachment-chain questions require an exact match to the canonical option set. Paired diagnostics compare identical question identifiers under different prompting or evidence conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 主要的 SpaceCast-Bench 评估使用带有确定性解码的标准思维链（CoT）提示。 CoT 条件要求先进行简要推理，最后一行给出最终选项；Direct 条件则仅要求给出最终选项。 单选题根据所选选项评分，而附加链问题则需要与标准选项集完全匹配。 成对诊断通过比较在不同提示或证据条件下具有相同问题标识符的测试来进行对比。

sents.zh: 主要的 SpaceCast-Bench 评估使用带有确定性解码的标准思维链（CoT）提示。

paragraphs.en: The primary Overall score is the macro-average of the 16 task-type accuracies, with each task type weighted equally. Static, Local, and Global scores average the task-type accuracies within each capability level; relation-type and reference-frame summaries are computed analogously.
paragraphs.zh: 主要总体得分是 16 项任务类型准确率的宏观平均值，且各项任务类型的权重相等。 静态、局部和全局得分分别对每个能力层级内的任务类型准确率进行平均；关系类型和参考框架的摘要也以类似方式计算。

paragraphs.en: Twelve volunteers answered the benchmark using only the model-visible views and answer options, without additional guidance. This evaluation was conducted independently from the ten-annotator quality-control review. Their type-macro accuracy was 87.2%, with 3,340 correct answers out of 3,862 questions. For the random baseline, we use seed 42 to sample uniformly from the displayed options for single-choice questions and from the eight valid answer sets for attachment-chain questions.
paragraphs.zh: 十二名志愿者仅使用模型可见的视图和答案选项，在没有额外指导的情况下回答了基准测试。 此次评估独立于十位标注员进行的质量控制审查。 他们的类型宏准确率为 87.2%，在 3,862 个问题中答对了 3,340 个。 对于随机基线，我们使用种子 42，对单选题从显示的选项中均匀采样，对附加链问题则从八个有效答案集中均匀采样。

sents.zh: 十二名志愿者仅使用模型可见的视图和答案选项，在没有额外指导的情况下回答了基准测试。

paragraphs.en: For each local-intervention question, we select an original RGB view covering the object’s post-intervention location and use depth and camera geometry to verify its visibility. The post-intervention 3D location is projected into the view to obtain a target mask. Qwen-Image-Edit and GPT-image-2 each receive the original RGB view, the intervention description, and the mask to generate an endpoint image. Answering models then receive only the generated image as additional evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个局部干预问题，我们选择一个覆盖物体干预后位置的原始 RGB 视图，并利用深度和相机几何信息验证其可见性。 将干预后的三维位置投影到该视图中，以获得目标掩码。 Qwen-Image-Edit 和 GPT-image-2 分别接收原始 RGB 视图、干预描述以及掩码，以生成最终图像。 随后，回答模型仅接收生成的图像作为额外证据。

paragraphs.en: Figures 11 – 14 present representative failure cases that reveal two intertwined limitations. The first is imperfect spatial perception: models construct only a shallow scene representation from the input views, anchoring on salient foreground objects or image-space cues rather than recovering consistent 3D structure. Depth ordering, ground-plane relations, and inter-object distances are frequently misestimated, and local observations across views are rarely integrated into a coherent whole. The second limitation is brittle transformation reasoning: even when the relevant objects are correctly located, models struggle to propagate an intervention through the scene. Movement direction is conflated with the resulting spatial relation, rigidly attached objects are left behind, and the post-intervention state is evaluated in the wrong reference frame or derived by a shallow 2D heuristic rather than genuine 3D recomputation. Removal questions expose a further failure mode in which visibility is only partially updated: models treat the deleted object as the sole occluder and equate a still-visible target with an unoccluded one. Taken together, these cases suggest that current vision-language models lack a persistent, manipulable scene representation, one that can be queried from an arbitrary viewpoint and updated under programmatic interventions, and that closing this gap is a prerequisite for reliable spatial reasoning in dynamic environments.
paragraphs.zh: 图 11–14 展示了典型的失败案例，揭示了两个相互交织的局限性。 第一个局限是不完美的空间感知：模型仅从输入视角构建浅层的场景表示，锚定在显著的前景物体或图像空间线索上，而非恢复一致的空间三维结构。 深度排序、地面平面关系以及物体间的距离常常被错误估计，且不同视角下的局部观察很少被整合为一个连贯的整体。 第二个局限是脆弱的变换推理：即使相关物体的位置被正确识别，模型仍难以将干预操作在整个场景中传播开来。 运动方向与由此产生的空间关系被混为一谈，刚性固定的物体被忽略，而干预后的状态则是在错误的参考系中评估，或由浅层的二维启发式方法推导，而非通过真正的三维重新计算得出。 移除问题暴露出另一种失败模式：可见性仅被部分更新，模型将被删除的物体视为唯一的遮挡物，并将仍然可见的目标等同于未被遮挡的物体。 综合来看，这些案例表明当前的视觉-语言模型缺乏一种持久且可操控的场景表示——这种表示应能从任意视角进行查询，并在程序化干预下得到更新；弥合这一差距是实现在动态环境中可靠空间推理的前提条件。
